Extract and carefully restore the EXISTING logo, not a new brand. Output ONE crisp flat PNG with a TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, compact wide horizontal composition around 2:1, no screenshot, mockup, stage or shadow. Preserve irregular friendly tall rounded dark-green uppercase PANIER, lime-green D’Herbi beneath, and the lime smiling shopping BAG mascot with deep-green handle/outline, two eyes, broad curved smile and a downward arrow along its left side. Faithful raster restoration of supplied identity for use on website and campaign packaging.

board.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, website concept revision. IMAGE1 IS THE EDIT TARGET: the user-approved Model1 'Le Panier en Mouvement' with hero 'LE QUOTIDIEN, EN PLUS SIMPLE.' IMAGE2 is the existing brand reference for package labels. Make ONE focused change to image1: replace ALL UNLABELLED GROCERY PACKAGING with beautifully designed PANIER D’HERBI branded labels. This includes every pasta/rice packet, tin can, jar, water bottle, juice bottle, biscuit bag and snack/chip packet in the HERO basket, the PRODUCT SHELF and the SERVICE bag scene. All those products should visibly carry coherent cream/forest-green/lime labels showing the current PANIER D’Herbi wordmark and the smiling green bag mascot, with small French category names such as Pâtes, Eau, Jus, Biscuits, Épicerie. No bare anonymous cans, blank bottles or unbranded snack packaging. Keep product visibility and natural packaging materials, transparent windows may show contents. Apples may have a tiny Panier d’Herbi sticker. These are illustrative campaign packaging designs, not an assertion of real private-label inventory. KEEP EVERYTHING ELSE AS CLOSE AS POSSIBLE: exact five chapters, their order and proportions, existing logo, typography style, original text, basket and lime orbital ribbon, shelf steps, slotted green service divider, actual facade reference, correct winter hours and final lime contact strip. Do NOT introduce a new layout, another model's hero or new content. Keep exact real phone 06 66 53 37 92 and address 13 place du Général d’Argence, 44410 Herbignac, Instagram @panier_dherbi. Winter hours Lun/Mar/Jeu 17h30–23h30; Mer fermé; Ven/Sam18h–2h; Dim13h–23h. Update small top presentation label to '01 — LE PANIER EN MOUVEMENT · ÉDITION SIGNÉE'. No browser/social screenshot UI. Preserve full tall page framing; do not crop the last section. Output opaque full-page concept board; main change is branded product labels everywhere.
